note: mock_rate encodes the IDEAL outcome so `--decider mock` demonstrates the pipeline; real deciders (api/claude-cli) ignore it and measure the description. audit-run executes ONE audit of the formal A-01…A-22 programme and releases a report in .md plus .pdf. The sharpest discriminators are scope and artefact: audit-plan owns the whole programme, audit-summary owns consolidation of finished reports, and the sec-*/refactor-* families own the same territory as working scans rather than as a formal audit with a reproducible findings register.
